description: An Obesity and Weight Management Counsellor supports individuals in achieving healthy weight goals through personalized counselling on nutrition, physical activity, and behavioral modification. The counsellor works closely with clients to assess dietary habits, body composition, and lifestyle patterns and recommends practical, sustainable changes. They may also conduct awareness sessions for school students, parents, and teachers under preventive health programs.
